backspace.description: Allows backspacing over everything in insert mode.

viminfo_size.description: Number of lines to keep in the .viminfo file for registers.

viminfo_registers.description: Maximum number of registers stored in the .viminfo file.

history.description: Number of command line history lines to keep.

ttimeoutlen.description: Timeout length in milliseconds for key codes.

scrolloff.description: Number of lines of context to keep around the cursor.

swap_directories.description: Comma-separated list of directories to avoid writing swapfiles to (e.g., for NFS/USB).

terminal_type.description: Terminal type to apply specific color settings for.

terminal_colors.description: Number of colors supported by the terminal.

local_config_file.description: Path to an optional global configuration file to source.
